mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(),0) submitted, COALESCE(SUM(() AND t.status='COMPLETED'),0) cohort_completed,COALESCE(SUM(),0) completed, COALESCE(SUM(),0) `open`,AVG(CASE WHEN THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,t.first_started_at,t.completed_repair_at)/1000000.0 END) average_repair_seconds, AVG(CASE WHEN THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,t.submitted_at,t.completed_at)/1000000.0 END) average_cycle_seconds FROM repair_tickets t t.store_id=#{storeId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.ticket_id IS NULL),0) pending_costs,COUNT(c.ticket_id) confirmed_costs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.confirmed_total,0)+c.labor_amount+c.other_amount END),0) completed_cost_amount FROM repair_tickets t LEFT JOIN repair_cost_confirmations c ON c.ticket_id=t.id LEFT JOIN repair_purchase_orders p ON p.ticket_id=t.id AND p.status IN ('ORDERED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED','RECEIVED') WHERE t.status='COMPLETED' AND AND t.store_id=#{storeId}

SELECT s.id,s.name,s.region,COALESCE(q.submitted,0) submitted,COALESCE(q.completed,0) completed,COALESCE(q.open,0) `open`,COALESCE(c.pending_costs,0) pending_costs,COALESCE(p.purchase_amount,0) purchase_amount,COALESCE(c.completed_cost_amount,0) completed_cost_amount,q.average_repair_seconds FROM repair_stores s LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.store_id,SUM(t.submitted_at>=#{period.from} AND t.submitted_at<#{period.to}) submitted,SUM(t.completed_at>=#{period.from} AND t.completed_at<#{period.to}) completed,SUM() `open`,AVG(CASE WHEN t.completed_at>=#{period.from} AND t.completed_at<#{period.to} THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,t.first_started_at,t.completed_repair_at)/1000000.0 END) average_repair_seconds FROM repair_tickets t GROUP BY t.store_id) q ON q.store_id=s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.store_id,SUM(p.confirmed_total) purchase_amount FROM repair_purchase_orders p JOIN repair_tickets t ON t.id=p.ticket_id WHERE p.status IN ('ORDERED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED','RECEIVED') AND p.ordered_at>=#{period.from} AND p.ordered_at<#{period.to} GROUP BY t.store_id) p ON p.store_id=s.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.store_id,SUM(c.ticket_id IS NULL) pending_costs,SUM(CASE WHEN c.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.confirmed_total,0)+c.labor_amount+c.other_amount END) completed_cost_amount FROM repair_tickets t LEFT JOIN repair_cost_confirmations c ON c.ticket_id=t.id LEFT JOIN repair_purchase_orders p ON p.ticket_id=t.id AND p.status IN ('ORDERED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED','RECEIVED') WHERE t.status='COMPLETED' AND t.completed_at>=#{period.from} AND t.completed_at<#{period.to} GROUP BY t.store_id) c ON c.store_id=s.id s.id=#{period.storeId} ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_members WHERE role='ENGINEER'

SELECT m.user_id id,m.display_name name,m.contact_phone,m.status member_status, COALESCE(q.assigned,0) assigned,COALESCE(q.accepted,0) accepted,COALESCE(q.in_progress,0) in_progress, COALESCE(q.waiting_acceptance,0) waiting_acceptance,COALESCE(q.current_open,0) current_open FROM repair_members m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT assignee_id,SUM(status='ASSIGNED') assigned,SUM(status='ACCEPTED') accepted, SUM(status='IN_PROGRESS') in_progress,SUM(status='WAITING_ACCEPTANCE') waiting_acceptance,COUNT(*) current_open FROM repair_tickets WHERE assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('ASSIGNED','ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS','WAITING_ACCEPTANCE') GROUP BY assignee_id ) q ON q.assignee_id=m.user_id WHERE m.role='ENGINEER' ORDER BY COALESCE(q.current_open,0) DESC,m.user_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.facility_snapshot,'$.brand')),'null') brand,NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.facility_snapshot,'$.model')),'null') model,COUNT(*) count FROM repair_tickets t WHERE AND t.store_id=#{storeId} GROUP BY brand,model ORDER BY count DESC,brand,model LIMIT 100

SELECT i.name,i.brand,i.model,SUM(i.quantity) quantity,CAST(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS CHAR) amount FROM repair_purchase_items i JOIN repair_purchase_orders p ON p.id=i.purchase_order_id JOIN repair_tickets t ON t.id=p.ticket_id WHERE p.status IN ('ORDERED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED','RECEIVED') AND p.ordered_at>=#{from} AND p.ordered_at<#{to} AND t.store_id=#{storeId} GROUP BY i.name,i.brand,i.model ORDER BY quantity DESC,i.name,i.brand,i.model LIMIT 100

SELECT t.id,t.ticket_no,t.title,s.name store_name,t.status,t.priority,t.submitted_at FROM repair_tickets t JOIN repair_stores s ON s.id=t.store_id WHERE AND t.status IN ('ASSIGNED','ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS')t.status='WAITING_ACCEPTANCE't.status IN ('SUBMITTED','WAITING_PROCUREMENT','READY_FOR_DISPATCH','WAITING_ACCEPTANCE') ORDER BY (t.priority='URGENT') DESC,t.submitted_at,t.id LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_tickets t WHERE AND ((t.status='SUBMITTED' AND DATE_ADD(t.submitted_at,INTERVAL #{reviewHours} HOUR)<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (t.status='ASSIGNED' AND DATE_ADD(t.assigned_at,INTERVAL #{acceptHours} HOUR)<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (t.status='IN_PROGRESS' AND DATE_ADD(t.first_started_at,INTERVAL #{repairHours} HOUR)<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (t.status='WAITING_ACCEPTANCE' AND DATE_ADD(t.submitted_for_acceptance_at,INTERVAL #{acceptanceHours} HOUR)<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))

SELECT t.ticket_no,t.title,s.name store_name,t.status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.facility_snapshot,'$.facilityName')) facility_name,NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.facility_snapshot,'$.brand')),'null') original_brand,NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.facility_snapshot,'$.model')),'null') original_model,m.display_name assignee_name,t.submitted_at,t.completed_at,COALESCE(p.confirmed_total,0) purchase_amount, CASE WHEN c.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.confirmed_total,0)+c.labor_amount+c.other_amount END total_amount FROM repair_tickets t JOIN repair_stores s ON s.id=t.store_id LEFT JOIN repair_members m ON m.user_id=t.assignee_id LEFT JOIN repair_purchase_orders p ON p.ticket_id=t.id AND p.status IN ('ORDERED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED','RECEIVED') LEFT JOIN repair_cost_confirmations c ON c.ticket_id=t.id WHERE AND t.store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 10001
